fit_reason: Whole 1993 Formula 31 PC cruiser offered by a private seller; a boat we can detail.
findings: Mottled, cloudy and dull gelcoat along the starboard hull side in the on-water photo, consistent with oxidation
Gray-streaked, flat-looking hull sides near the bow under the registration numbers
Hull side in the storage barn photo looks brighter, so some photos show the boat noticeably duller than others
Teal and pink hull striping looks somewhat faded in the on-water shots
Faint brownish staining along the hull just above the waterline in the on-water photo
message: Hi Steve, we saw your listing for the 1993 Formula 31 PC. In the photo out on the water the starboard hull looks cloudy and blotchy, and there is some light staining along the waterline. We do mobile gelcoat oxidation removal and polish that would bring back the gloss before you show it to buyers. Would you like a quote?
